S00.prompt:
Create a 26s serious, slow-burn cinematic historical drama scene.

Characters: @Qutuz, @ElderEmir
Locations: @QutuzTent

Visual Style: 2D anime, serious historical drama, soft cel shading, painterly backgrounds.
[Negative: chinese language, mandarin, chinese speech, asian accent]
[System: Language: English] [Audio: English Speech]

@Qutuz and @ElderEmir are inside @QutuzTent in the Salihiyya camp, at night in 1259.

@Qutuz stands over a map of Syria. The @ElderEmir waits at the tent flap. One torch is the only light.

Preserve the exact established designs, proportions, clothing, locations, lighting, colors, and visual style for @Qutuz, @ElderEmir and @QutuzTent.

IMPORTANT:

Use ONLY hard cuts between shots.
NO tracking shots, camera slides, whip pans, or continuous camera transitions.
Every shot is a locked-off frame.
Keep the pacing measured, tense, and cinematic. The silence between the lines carries the tension.
The single torch is the ONLY light source: warm orange on faces, deep shadow everywhere else.
No on-screen text, subtitles or captions anywhere in the frame.
NO music. Only the crackle of the torch, wind against the tent canvas, slow breathing, cloth and metal sounds, and dialogue.

ELDER EMIR'S VOICE:

Older adult male voice. Dry, weary, measured delivery, a little careful.

QUTUZ'S VOICE:

Adult male voice. Low pitch, stern tone, steady and unhurried delivery, clear articulation. He never raises it.

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:03) — WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT — EYE LEVEL

Inside @QutuzTent, seen from the entrance side. Canvas walls fall away into deep shadow. A single torch burns on a pole. A map of Syria lies on a low table at the center. @Qutuz stands over it, small in the frame. The @ElderEmir waits at the tent flap in the foreground, a dark silhouette at the left edge.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 (00:03-00:05) — MEDIUM SHOT ON QUTUZ — SLIGHT LOW ANGLE

@Qutuz stands over the map with both hands resting on the table. Torchlight catches the scar on his cheek. He does not look up.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 (00:05-00:09) — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP ON THE ELDER EMIR — EYE LEVEL

The @ElderEmir at the tent flap, his grey beard lit orange from the side. He speaks carefully, like a man testing how far he can go.

@ElderEmir, in his SAME dry, weary voice, careful and level:

“They will say a slave took the throne of Egypt.”

HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 (00:09-00:14) — CLOSE-UP ON QUTUZ — LOW ANGLE

@Qutuz finally looks up. His eyes are steady and the torch is reflected in them. He speaks without anger.

@Qutuz, in his SAME low, stern voice, flat and certain:

“Let them. The Mongols never ask who sits on a throne.”

HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 (00:14-00:16) — EXTREME CLOSE-UP — INSERT — TOP-DOWN

@Qutuz's scarred hand lies flat on the northern edge of the map of Syria. His voice continues from OFF-SCREEN, quiet and sure.

@Qutuz, in his SAME low, stern voice, quiet and sure:

“They ask if it stands.”

HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 (00:16-00:18) — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP ON THE ELDER EMIR — EYE LEVEL

The @ElderEmir hesitates before he asks.

@ElderEmir, in his SAME dry, weary voice, hesitant:

“And the boy sultan?”

HARD CUT.

SHOT 7 (00:18-00:21) — CLOSE-UP ON QUTUZ — LOW ANGLE

@Qutuz keeps his eyes on the map and answers at once.

@Qutuz, in his SAME low, stern voice, flat, final:

“A boy cannot lift a sword.”

HARD CUT.
